tagline.en: A short freeway from Zuoying, by the high-speed rail station, across both north–south freeways to Qishan
tagline.zh: 自高铁左营站旁出发，横越两条南北向高速公路直抵旗山的短程国道

start.en: Zuoying end, at Wenzi Road and Dazhong Road, Zuoying District, Kaohsiung, where the Kaohsiung Metropolitan Expressway carries on
start.zh: 高雄市左营区左营端，文自路与大中路一带，向西续接高雄都会区快速道路

end.en: Qishan end, Qishan District, Kaohsiung, on Provincial Highway 3 towards Meinong
end.zh: 高雄市旗山区旗山端，接台 3 线，可往美浓

en: National Freeway 10 runs 33.8 km from Zuoying in the north of Kaohsiung to Qishan in the foothills. From its western end, where it continues as the elevated Kaohsiung Metropolitan Expressway and has ramps into the Zuoying high-speed rail station, it meets Freeway 1 at the Dingjin junction, turns north through Renwu, Dashe and Yanchao, meets Freeway 3 at the Yanchao junction, then heads north-east up the Qishan valley. A short stretch crosses into Ligang in Pingtung county.

It was planned as two pieces: the Kaohsiung Ring, about 18 km west of Freeway 3, and the Qishan branch, about 14 km east of it. With Freeways 1 and 3 and Provincial Highway 88 it forms a ring round the Kaohsiung–Pingtung area.
zh: 国道十号自高雄北区的左营至山麓的旗山，全长 33.8 公里。西端续接高架的高雄都会区快速道路，并设匝道直接进出高铁左营站；向东在鼎金系统交流道与国道一号交会，转北经仁武、大社、燕巢，于燕巢系统交流道与国道三号交会，再往东北沿旗山溪谷而上。其中一小段经过屏东县里港乡。
它规划时分为两段：国道三号以西约 18 公里的高雄环线，与以东约 14 公里的旗山支线。它与国道一号、国道三号及台 88 线共同组成高屏地区的环状路网。

en: The road is six lanes between the Dingjin and Yanchao junctions and four elsewhere. Interchanges are at Zuoying, Dingjin, Renwu, Yanchao, the Yanchao junction, Lingkou, Ligang and Qishan; Lingkou and Ligang are half interchanges, eastbound off and westbound on only, and Lingkou is signed for Fo Guang Shan monastery.

Dingjin was built without a link from eastbound Freeway 10 to northbound Freeway 1, so that traffic had to drop onto Dazhong Road underneath. A 1.12 km steel-box-girder ramp, begun on 5 March 2018, closed the gap on 31 January 2021. The Ligang interchange, opened on 8 November 2014, was paired with a dedicated road for gravel lorries.
zh: 鼎金系统交流道至燕巢系统交流道为双向六车道，其余路段为双向四车道。沿线设有左营端、鼎金系统、仁武、燕巢、燕巢系统、岭口、里港与旗山端等交流道；岭口与里港为半套交流道，只有东出与西入匝道，岭口交流道并指示往佛光山。
鼎金系统交流道当初没有自国道十号东行接国道一号北上的匝道，车辆须下到桥下的大中路平面转接。2018 年 3 月 5 日动工的一条长约 1.12 公里的钢箱梁匝道，于 2021 年 1 月 31 日通车，补上了这个缺口。2014 年 11 月 8 日通车的里港交流道，则搭配了一条砂石车专用道。

en: The branch was part of the Second Freeway follow-on programme, whose feasibility study began in August 1987 and engineering planning in July 1989. The engineering bureau built it at a time when, for the follow-on programme, it had moved every contract to open tender.

It opened in stages in December 1997, November 1998 and, with the whole road, on 14 November 1999. The Yanchao junction was connected to Freeway 3 on 30 December 1999, the day the Yanchao–Jiuru section of that road opened.

Traffic grew after the high-speed rail opened, since the freeway is the direct road from Zuoying station to the towns to the east; the legislature later pressed the transport ministry to pay for the missing Dingjin ramp. In November 2011 the E01 Qimei express from the station to Qishan and Meinong began as Taiwan's first all-electric bus route.

Meinong, Gaoshu, Liugui and Maolin long asked for the freeway to be carried on to the Xinwei bridge. A 2012 highways-directorate study found an expressway along Highway 28 too hard and not worth it, and the extension was built instead as an ordinary provincial road from the Ligang interchange; on 13 August 2024 the Executive Yuan numbered it as part of Provincial Highway 27A, not Freeway 10. A system interchange at Renwu, for Freeway 7 and a second Kaohsiung–Pingtung expressway, and a new interchange at Dashe are being planned.
zh: 高雄支线属于第二高速公路后续计划；该计划于 1987 年 8 月开始可行性研究，1989 年 7 月展开工程规划。全线由国工局兴建，当时后续计划的工程已全面改为公开招标。
全线分别于 1997 年 12 月、1998 年 11 月分段通车，1999 年 11 月 14 日全线通车。燕巢系统交流道则于 1999 年 12 月 30 日、国道三号燕巢九如段通车当天接通国道三号。
高铁通车后，作为左营站通往东侧乡镇的直接道路，国道十号车流日增；立法院其后要求交通部全额补助兴建鼎金交流道缺少的匝道。2011 年 11 月，自高铁站开往旗山、美浓的 E01 旗美快线上路，是全台第一条纯电动公交路线。
美浓、高树、六龟与茂林等地长期争取国道十号延伸至新威大桥。公路总局 2012 年的初步评估认为沿台 28 线兴建快速公路工程难度高、经济效益不足，改以里港交流道为起点兴建一般省道；2024 年 8 月 13 日，行政院公告该路段编入台 27 甲线，而非国道十号的延长。衔接国道七号与高屏第二快速公路的仁武系统交流道，以及大社交流道，目前都在规划中。

en: No cost for the branch on its own has been found. It was built within the Second Freeway follow-on programme, budgeted by the Executive Yuan at NT$525.1 billion for the main line from Hsiangshan to Linbian and all its branches; the bureau's former director says the programme was let for far less, NT$254.2 billion being saved in all.

Later works are costed separately. The Dingjin ramp cost about NT$690 million, paid by the Freeway Bureau and built for it by Kaohsiung city's new-works office; the Ligang gravel-lorry road was reported in 2010 at NT$1.4 billion and finished in 2014 for about NT$950 million in works.
zh: 目前查不到高雄支线单独的造价。它包含在第二高速公路后续计划之中，该计划经行政院核定的预算为 5,251 亿元，涵盖香山至林边主线及全部环支线；据前国工局长回忆，计划发包金额远低于预算，共节约 2,542 亿元。
后来的工程则另行计价。鼎金系统交流道新增匝道约 6.9 亿元，由高速公路局编列经费，委托高雄市政府新建工程处施工；里港砂石车专用道 2010 年报道约 14 亿元，2014 年完工，工程经费约 9.5 亿元。

en: At opening in 1999 the limit was 60 km/h west of Renwu and 80 east of it. Both were raised on 15 April 2003, to 80 and 90, and the eastern part went to 100 on 1 September 2008. The limit drops from about the 32 km mark as the road approaches its end at Qishan.
zh: 1999 年通车时，仁武交流道以西速限每小时 60 公里，以东 80 公里。2003 年 4 月 15 日分别提高为 80 与 90 公里，2008 年 9 月 1 日起仁武以东提高为 100 公里。约自 32 公里处起，因接近旗山端终点开始降速。

why.en: No separate figure has been found. The branch was financed within the Second Freeway follow-on programme, whose NT$525.1 billion budget covered Freeway 3 from Hsiangshan to Linbian and Freeways 4, 6, 8 and 10 together.
why.zh: 未查到单独的造价。高雄支线经费包含在第二高速公路后续计划之内，该计划 5,251 亿元的预算合并涵盖国道三号香山至林边段及国道四、六、八、十号。

value.en: Central government, through the Executive Yuan's Second Freeway follow-on programme budget. The 2021 Dingjin ramp was paid for by the Freeway Bureau.
value.zh: 中央政府出资，列入行政院核定的第二高速公路后续计划预算。2021 年的鼎金新增匝道由高速公路局编列经费。

王淑芬, “疏解壅塞 鼎金系統國10接國1北上匝道31日通車”, Central News Agency, 28 January 2021

value.en: About NT$1.4 billion as reported in 2010, the county's revised figure, then awaiting the Council for Economic Planning and Development's approval; completed on 2 September 2014 for about NT$950 million in works
value.zh: 2010 年报道约 14 亿元，为县府修正后的数字，当时尚待经建会核定；2014 年 9 月 2 日完工，工程经费约 9.5 亿元

value.en: 33.8 km: the Kaohsiung Ring about 18 km and the Qishan branch about 14 km as planned
value.zh: 33.8 公里；规划时高雄环线约 18 公里、旗山支线约 14 公里

figures.source: Chinese Wikipedia, 國道十號 (中華民國); CECI Engineering Consultants, 中華技術 no. 123, August 2019

timeline.en: The feasibility study for the Second Freeway follow-on programme, including the Kaohsiung branch, begins in August.
timeline.zh: 8 月，包含高雄支线在内的第二高速公路后续计划开始可行性研究。

timeline.en: The first section opens in December.
A second section opens in November.
The whole road opens on 14 November; the Yanchao junction joins Freeway 3 on 30 December.
timeline.zh: 11 月 14 日全线通车；12 月 30 日燕巢系统交流道接通国道三号。

timeline.en: Limits are raised on 15 April, to 80 km/h west of Renwu and 90 east.
timeline.zh: 4 月 15 日速限提高，仁武以西 80 公里、以东 90 公里。

timeline.en: The limit east of Renwu becomes 100 km/h on 1 September.
timeline.zh: 9 月 1 日仁武以东速限提高为 100 公里。

timeline.en: The E01 electric bus from Zuoying high-speed rail station to Qishan and Meinong begins in November.
timeline.zh: 11 月，高铁左营站往旗山、美浓的 E01 纯电动公交路线上路。

timeline.en: The Ligang interchange opens on 8 November.
timeline.zh: 11 月 8 日里港交流道通车。

timeline.en: The Dingjin ramp from eastbound Freeway 10 to northbound Freeway 1 opens on 31 January.
timeline.zh: 1 月 31 日，鼎金系统交流道国道十号东行接国道一号北上匝道通车。

timeline.en: The extension from Ligang to the Xinwei bridge is numbered Provincial Highway 27A on 13 August.
timeline.zh: 8 月 13 日，里港至新威大桥的延伸路段编为台 27 甲线。
